output.technical_predicate: Partner-confirmed income band (cases.confirmed, set by the officer "verify"/"notify-release" actions) must be used only for underwriting (the automatic "score" decision and human review). Marketing selection and delivery (campaign audience, promotion jobs) must be restricted to permitted subscription/consent fields (choices: promotions, objection) and case eligibility fields (restricted flag, stage), and must not read the confirmed income band.
applicability_facts: Scenario: opted-in subscriber holds a partner-confirmed income band for underwriting.
Scenario: no compatible marketing purpose and no new legal basis exists for targeting with that band.
store.py:0157-0160 verify stores partner band in cases.confirmed; store.py:0180-0182 notify-release also writes confirmed.
store.py:0131-0135 score job reads c['confirmed'] or c['income'] for the underwriting decision.
store.py:0100-0103 eligible_campaign selects only owner, restricted and stage, then checks promotions/objection choices.
store.py:0140-0142 promotion job delivery calls eligible_campaign and writes a generic event without income data.
store.py:0105-0109 campaign queues promotion jobs only for cases passing eligible_campaign.
relevant_exceptions: Compatible-purpose or new-legal-basis reuse under Art. 6(4) is not established by the scenario; no such basis is modeled in the source.
Consent-based marketing (choices 'promotions' on, 'objection' off) is a separate permitted basis for marketing selection, not for income-band targeting.
required_controls: Underwriting-only read of cases.confirmed: only the score job (store.py:0131-0135) and human review path may consume the confirmed band.
Campaign audience function (store.py:0100-0103) must derive eligibility solely from identity, promotions/objection choices, restricted flag and stage — no income or confirmed field.
Promotion delivery (store.py:0140-0142) must emit no income-band value in the event body or payload.
Officer campaign entry point (store.py:0105-0109) must not pass or join income/confirmed columns into marketing selection.
Preference/objection handling (store.py:0092-0098) must cancel queued promotion jobs on opt-out or objection.
